summary: Iteration 17 — Frontend-only retest of the two fixes from iteration 16: (a) custom confirm Modal (chat-profile-confirm-ok / chat-profile-confirm-cancel) replacing Alert.alert for Block/Unblock and 'Set up chat lock first' nag; (b) submitLock() now calls markUnlocked(threadId) before reload() so locking from inside the open chat doesn't bounce the user to ChatLockGate. Tested as Alice (test_alice_73dc7f@test.com) against Bob in thread 4f3c5028-706f-43fa-a57b-494b13787718. RESULT: The fix code is PRESENT and looks correct on read-through, BUT NEW REGRESSION ON WEB PREVIEW — neither the chat-profile-lock nor the chat-profile-block rows fire their onPress handlers any more. Wallpaper row (chat-profile-wallpaper), which sits between them and is the only row without an inline Modal sibling, still works (verified — navigates to /chat/settings on tap). Lock + Block rows do nothing: tried page.click(force=True), mouse.down()/up() at row center, dispatching pointerdown/pointerup/touchstart/touchend, and even calling the React onClick prop directly via __reactProps$ — no state change, no API call, no confirm modal. The handlers are wired (onClick is present in __reactProps), they just appear to no-op. STRONG HYPOTHESIS: adding the second `<Modal>` (visible={!!confirm}) inside ProfilePrivacyBlockRows alongside the existing pinSheet Modal has broken sibling click handling on react-native-web — likely a Portal/event-capture interaction. The iteration 16 tester explicitly verified Lock-with-PIN tap → PIN sheet opens on this same screen, so the regression was introduced by the iteration 17 confirm-Modal addition. Block + no-PIN nag therefore CANNOT BE VERIFIED end-to-end on web; the markUnlocked-before-reload fix likewise cannot be exercised because the PIN sheet can never be opened from the profile modal. Wallpaper jump + profile-card avatar/refid/media/starred summary still render correctly. Composer + long-press action sheet not specifically re-exercised but were passing in iteration 16 and code in those regions is unchanged.

action_items: ROOT-CAUSE the click regression on chat-profile-lock + chat-profile-block. Wallpaper row in the same component still works, so layout/z-index is fine; the difference is that lock & block siblings each set local state that toggles a sibling <Modal>. Likely fixes to try: (1) collapse the two Modals (pinSheet + confirm) into a single conditional Modal — react-native-web seems to misbehave when two sibling <Modal>s are mounted with visible=false; (2) move the confirm + pinSheet Modal markup out of ProfilePrivacyBlockRows and up to the parent ChatThreadScreen tree (or render them as inline absolute Views instead of <Modal>); (3) reproduce with a minimal repro and confirm by temporarily removing the confirm Modal — if Lock then works, that's the culprit.

After the click handlers fire again, the three retest scenarios from the review request can be verified directly: Block/Unblock with confirm-ok, no-PIN nag → /chat/settings, PIN-gated lock that no longer bounces to gate (markUnlocked + reload).

Optional hardening: instead of `<Modal visible={!!confirm}>` consider always-rendered inline View with absolute positioning, or use the same single Modal whose body switches based on a `mode` state. Keeps RNW happy and reduces portal churn.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:843 + :873 — two sibling <Modal>s inside ProfilePrivacyBlockRows. On react-native-web, Modal renders a Portal each render, and two of them mounted simultaneously appears to disturb pointer-event delivery to surrounding TouchableOpacity rows. This is the most likely culprit for the click regression.
/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:719-725 — refreshBlocks() uses GET /chat/blocks and recomputes blocked from the list; called on mount AND after POST/DELETE. Correct per review-request item 1.

/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:756 — markUnlocked(threadId) called BEFORE await reload(). Order matters: reload triggers settings refetch which re-evaluates isThreadLocked → ChatLockGate would mount; calling markUnlocked first sets the in-session unlock flag so the gate stays bypassed. Correct fix as described.
/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:774-792 — toggleBlock no longer optimistically flips state; awaits refreshBlocks() after POST/DELETE. Matches the review-request requirement.

/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:879-887 — confirm-cancel + confirm-ok testIDs are present with correct destructive styling (#B3261E) on Block. Modal body is destructured from the confirm state. Implementation looks fine in isolation — it just can't be reached.

rca_of_issue: RCA (high confidence): In iteration 16, ProfilePrivacyBlockRows had ONE inline <Modal> (the PIN sheet at line 843). In iteration 17, a SECOND inline <Modal> was added immediately after for the confirm sheet (line 873). On react-native-web, each <Modal> mounts via Portal into a top-level overlay tree. When two sibling Modals with visible=false coexist in the same component, RNW appears to mis-route pointer events for sibling TouchableOpacity nodes in the same render tree — specifically the chat-profile-lock and chat-profile-block rows. The wallpaper row, whose onPress does NOT depend on either of the two Modals, still works, which rules out a layout/overlay/z-index cause. Reproduction steps: (1) login Alice, navigate to /chat/4f3c5028-706f-43fa-a57b-494b13787718; (2) tap header — profile modal opens; (3) tap 'Block Bob' or 'Lock this chat' — no effect, no API call, no confirm modal. Mitigation: collapse the two Modals into one (driven by a discriminated state) OR convert the PIN/confirm sheets to inline absolute-positioned overlays without <Modal>. Verify by temporarily commenting out the confirm <Modal> — Lock row should immediately start working again. (Native iOS/Android likely unaffected because RN's Modal does not use a web Portal.)
